name: world-cup-26-sedes
description: Plataforma de consulta y administracion de las sedes del Mundial 2026. Backend Express + MongoDB + JWT y frontend React.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"

author: Gaston Costabella
